subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this compatibility-sensitive Unix process cleanup change as the fix for the linked gateway SIGTERM regression?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but it changes the shared omitted-option kill-tree default and therefore needs maintainer ownership of the compatibility and availability tradeoff before merge.

options.title: Accept the guarded default
options.body: Treat leader verification plus explicit detached caller forwarding as the preferred fix, and land once required checks are acceptable.

options.title: Ask for more upgrade proof
options.body: Request additional merge-head or Linux no-ps validation before accepting the shared default change.

options.title: Reject default semantics change
options.body: Pause or replace this PR with a narrower caller-only repair if maintainers want omitted cleanup semantics preserved exactly.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded default
recommendation.body: Treat leader verification plus explicit detached caller forwarding as the preferred fix, and land once required checks are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: The reported regression depends on service-managed child detachment behavior that Peter authored, making him the best routing candidate among the history signals.
